title: ConnectorItemDefinition
description: JSON Schema for the Fabric Universal Connector item definition stored in payload.json (Base64-encoded). Version 1.0.0.

ModuleType.description: Identifies the source system module. Determines which runtime connector and Bronze schema to use.

ConnectorState.description: Lifecycle state of the ConnectorItem. 'empty' = wizard not completed. 'configured' = fully activated. 'error' = last activation failed. 'paused' = schedule disabled.

AuthMode.description: Authentication strategy for connecting to the source system.

SchemaEvolutionPolicy.description: Controls runtime behavior when source schema changes are detected. 'merge' = add new columns (default). 'strict' = fail run. 'overwrite' = rebuild table (destroys history).

ExtractionMode.description: Incremental uses watermark/delta-token for change tracking. Full re-extracts all records each run (expensive — avoid in production).

CrmSourceConfiguration.description: Source configuration for Microsoft Dataverse / Dynamics 365 CRM.

tenantId.description: Entra ID tenant ID that hosts the Dataverse environment.

apiVersion.description: Dataverse Web API version. Default: v9.2.

enableChangeTracking.description: Use OData delta tokens for incremental extraction. Requires Change Tracking enabled on each entity in Dataverse admin.

pageSize.description: Number of records per OData page request. Dataverse max is 5000.

BusinessCentralSourceConfiguration.description: Source configuration for Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central.

tenantId.description: Entra ID tenant ID that hosts the BC environment.

companyId.description: BC Company ID (UUID or name). If null, extracts from all companies.

apiVersion.description: BC REST API version. Default: v2.0.

pageSize.description: Number of records per OData page request.

SqlSourceConfiguration.description: Source configuration for SQL Server or Azure SQL.

server.description: SQL Server hostname or Azure SQL FQDN (e.g. server.database.windows.net).

driver.description: JDBC driver variant. 'azuresql' enables MSI authentication.

trustServerCertificate.description: Trust self-signed server certificates. Set true only for dev/test on-premises SQL.

fetchSize.description: JDBC fetch size (rows per network round-trip).

FabricConnectionAuth.description: Authenticate via a Fabric Connection managed by the Fabric platform. The connection stores credentials; only the connection UUID is stored in the item definition.

fabricConnectionId.description: UUID of the Fabric Connection that holds source credentials.

KeyVaultReferenceAuth.description: Authenticate by resolving a secret from Azure Key Vault at runtime. The notebook resolves the secret using its MSI identity.

clientIdSecretName.description: Key Vault secret name containing the OAuth client ID (if not using fabricConnectionId).

clientSecretName.description: Key Vault secret name containing the OAuth client secret or password.

tenantIdSecretName.description: Key Vault secret name containing the Entra ID tenant ID for this source.

ServicePrincipalAuth.description: Authenticate via service principal. Client ID and tenant are stored in the item definition. The client secret is NEVER stored here — it must always reference a Fabric Connection or Key Vault secret.

tenantId.description: Entra ID tenant ID for this service principal.

clientId.description: Application (client) ID of the service principal.

secretRef.description: Reference to where the client secret is stored. NEVER store the raw secret value here.

AuthConfiguration.description: Authentication configuration for connecting to the source system. The active variant is determined by the 'mode' discriminator.

CrmEntityConfiguration.description: Entity configuration for a single Dataverse entity.

displayName.description: Human-readable display name shown in the UI.

enabled.description: If false, this entity is skipped during ingestion runs.

selectColumns.description: OData $select fields. If empty, all columns are extracted.

filterExpression.description: Additional OData $filter expression appended to the extraction query.

batchSize.description: Records per OData page for this entity. Overrides source-level pageSize.

BusinessCentralEntityConfiguration.description: Entity configuration for a single Business Central API entity.

watermarkColumn.description: ISO datetime column used for incremental watermark filtering.

selectColumns.description: OData $select fields. If empty, all columns extracted.

filterExpression.description: Additional OData $filter expression for this entity.

SqlEntityConfiguration.description: Entity configuration for a single SQL table or view.

watermarkColumn.description: Column used for incremental watermark (e.g. 'ModifiedAt', 'RowVersion'). Required if extractionMode = 'incremental'.

watermarkColumnType.description: Data type of the watermark column. Determines comparison operator used in WHERE clause.

selectColumns.description: Columns to extract. If empty, SELECT * is used.

whereClause.description: Additional WHERE predicate (without WHERE keyword). Appended with AND to the watermark filter.

primaryKeys.description: Primary key columns. Used for upsert logic in future Silver layer.

fetchSize.description: JDBC fetch size override for this table.

bronzeLakeHouseId.description: Fabric Lakehouse item ID. Null before activation; populated by the Activate handler.

bronzeLakeHouseName.description: Lakehouse display name. Used to create the Lakehouse if it does not exist.

schemaEvolutionPolicy.description: Global schema evolution policy. Can be overridden per entity in Phase 2.

retentionDays.description: Optional Delta Lake table retention in days. If null, Fabric default retention applies.

useExistingLakehouse.description: If true, bronzeLakeHouseId must point to an existing Lakehouse. The workload will not create a new one.

SchedulingConfiguration.description: Fabric Job Scheduler configuration for automated ingestion runs.

scheduleType.description: 'cron' for full cron expression. 'interval' for simple recurrence in minutes.

cronExpression.description: Standard 5-field cron expression (min hour dom month dow). Required if scheduleType = 'cron'. Example: '0 2 * * *' (daily at 02:00).

intervalMinutes.description: Recurrence interval in minutes. Required if scheduleType = 'interval'. Minimum 15 minutes.

timezone.description: IANA timezone name (e.g. 'Europe/Rome', 'America/New_York'). Used to interpret the cron expression.

enabled.description: If false, the schedule is registered but disabled (paused state).

startDate.description: Schedule effective start datetime. If null, schedule activates immediately.

FeaturesConfiguration.description: Feature flags controlling runtime behavior. All defaults reflect production-safe settings.

schemaEvolutionHandling.description: Controls what happens when the source entity schema changes between runs.

errorThresholdPercent.description: Percentage of entities that may fail before the entire run is aborted. 0 = fail immediately on first error. 100 = always attempt all entities.

enablePartialRun.description: If true, a failed entity does not stop other entities from processing (up to errorThresholdPercent).

enableTelemetry.description: Anonymous opt-in telemetry. Reports run success/failure counts and wheel version to ISV Application Insights. No customer data is transmitted.

maxRecordsPerEntityPerRun.description: Optional cap on records extracted per entity per run. Useful for initial-load throttling. If null, no cap.

enableDeltaLakeOptimize.description: Run OPTIMIZE + VACUUM after each write. Improves query performance at the cost of longer run time.

RuntimeConfiguration.description: Runtime state populated by the Activate handler. Not set by the wizard. Treated as read-only by the UI after activation.

notebookItemId.description: Fabric Notebook item ID deployed to the customer workspace.

bronzeLakeHouseId.description: Resolved Fabric Lakehouse item ID (created or referenced at activation).

deployedAt.description: ISO 8601 UTC datetime of the Activate operation.

wheelVersion.description: Python wheel version pinned at activation time (e.g. '1.0.0').

configSchemaVersion.description: Version of this JSON Schema that was current when the config was written.

jobScheduleId.description: Fabric Job Scheduler schedule ID returned by createItemSchedule.

ConnectorMetadata.description: User-facing metadata for display and auditing. Not used by the runtime.

displayName.description: User-assigned name for this connector instance (shown in dashboard header).

tags.description: Optional tags for filtering/grouping in workspace views.

createdAt.description: ISO 8601 UTC datetime when the ConnectorItem was first created.

updatedAt.description: ISO 8601 UTC datetime of the last configuration save.

activatedAt.description: ISO 8601 UTC datetime of the last successful Activate operation.

schemaVersion.description: Version of this schema. Must be '1.0.0' for this release. Used by the Python wheel to select the correct deserializer.

authentication.description: Authentication configuration for the source system.

entities.description: Dataverse entities to ingest. At least one must be enabled.
BC API entities to ingest. At least one must be enabled.

oneOf.description: SQL Server / Azure SQL module variant

entities.description: SQL tables or views to ingest. At least one must be enabled.

metadata.description: Marketing Cloud entities from Contoso Dataverse
